# Modules whose interface units still keep function bodies: rule 3 of the module
# layout, checked by tbc-lint --checks=interface-bodies. One module per line; a
# partition counts as its module. The check fails on a body in any other module
# and on a listed module whose interfaces keep none, so each task that moves a
# module's bodies out deletes its line.
